title: Editor E0 task 12b, binding slice: the canvas block and publish bar serve both the live and the node store
detail: Decomposed from PROG-E0 on 2026-10-19. components/entity-blocks/editor-binding.tsx: useEditorBinding returns the selection and autosave slice of the node store once seeded, else of the live store. SpaceCanvasBlock and SpacePublishFab read it; SpaceCanvasBlock takes an optional nid so selection is by node id on the node path. The node store gains selectedItemIndex and selectItem. Inert: nothing seeds the node store, so no surface changes. Honest gap: the on-page node grid, the builder, block-edit-panel and the owner preview choice are still to come.

verify.cmd: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const bad=[];const rd=f=>fs.readFileSync(f,'utf8');if(!rd('components/entity-blocks/editor-binding.tsx').includes('node?.seeded'))bad.push('binding does not prefer a seeded node store');for(const f of ['components/entity-blocks/space-publish-fab.tsx','components/entity-blocks/space-canvas/space-canvas-block.tsx'])if(!rd(f).includes('useEditorBinding'))bad.push(f+' bypasses the binding');if(!rd('components/entity-blocks/space-canvas/space-canvas-block.tsx').includes('select(nid ?? id)'))bad.push('canvas block does not select by nid');if(bad.length){console.error('LIVE-1006: '+bad.join('; '));process.exit(1)}"
verify.note: Fails when either consumer stops reading the binding or the canvas block stops selecting by node id. Behavior is editor-binding.test.tsx.
